name: github-pr-helper
description: Review GitHub pull requests with evidence-backed findings and clear next steps.

interface.longDescription: A skill-only Codex plugin for reviewing GitHub pull requests, local changes, regressions, tests, and security-sensitive code.
defaultPrompt: Review this pull request and prioritize concrete risks.
Audit this diff for regressions and missing tests.
Find security-sensitive changes in this pull request.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the evidence-backed GitHub pull request review workflow.
